maria (PM): Hey team — we need to triage the Optimize recommendations asks that Sales/CS surfaced: deterministic batching presets, simpler prefix/KV cache controls, and per-model quantization guidance. Can we agree an MVP PRD scope and acceptance criteria?

raj (ML Eng): quick notes: batching presets should be heuristics + exposed knobs. requirement: predictable P50 latency. caching needs TTL + explicit invalidate endpoint. quant guidance = model-family -> quant level + expected quality delta.

sam (Infra): Dedicated/Private customers need config-as-code and safer defaults. Also we must have an infra rollback path if batching increases tail latency.

elaine (DevEx): Customers ask for a one-click Console recommendation and a CLI/api for infra automation. UX must hide advanced knobs by default.

maria (PM): Draft MVP scope (3 features):
1) Batching presets: low-latency, balanced, high-throughput with default timeouts and batch sizes per GPU class.
2) Prefix/KV cache controls: enable/disable, TTL, explicit invalidate route, and per-tenant defaulting.
3) Quantization recommendations: public doc + automated eval harness that runs golden promptsets and blocks regressed model-quant combos.

raj (ML Eng): Acceptance criteria proposals:
- Latency: "low-latency" preset P50 must not increase >5% vs current baseline; P99 must not regress >10% in canary region.
- Throughput: "high-throughput" should increase tokens/sec by >=20% on 2+ benchmark traces.
- Cost: recommendations return expected token-cost delta per 100k tokens.
- Quality: automated eval must block rollout if metric drop >=1% (BLEU/ROUGE/perplexity delta depending on model/task).

sam (Infra): Edge cases for RFC:
- Short requests (<=8 tokens) bypass batching; ensure max-wait <3ms for low-latency preset.
- Mixed workloads: enforce per-route batching policies to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Model rollouts: automatically invalidate prefix/KV cache on model version changes unless customer opts out.

elaine (DevEx): UX acceptance:
- Console: "Apply recommendation" CTA that shows preview of latency/cost impact and links to pre-run eval report.
- CLI: `redwood optimize recommend --model rdx-v1 --preset balanced` returns JSON: {preset, expected_p50_ms, expected_cost_delta}.

maria (PM): Quick config sketch for RFC (YAML):
```
optimize:
  presets:
    low-latency:
      max_wait_ms: 3
      max_batch_size: 8
    balanced:
      max_wait_ms: 12
      max_batch_size: 64
    high-throughput:
      max_wait_ms: 40
      max_batch_size: 512
  caching:
    enabled: true
    ttl_s: 3600
    invalidate_on_model_version_change: true
```

raj (ML Eng): For quant guidance: propose a matrix mapping model family + workload type -> recommended quant level (e.g., fp16, int8, 4-bit) and expected perplexity/accuracy delta. We'll run cheap A/B evals on a held promptset and gate by the quality threshold.

sam (Infra): Rollout plan and safety nets for RFC:
- Canary: 10% traffic in a single region (internal only) for 48h.
- Metrics: latency (P50/P95/P99), tokens/sec, cost delta, eval quality metrics.
- Auto-rollback triggers: P99 latency increase >15% or quality regression threshold exceeded.

maria (PM): Owners: raj + elaine to draft RFC technical + UX; sam to write rollout/runbook; I'll own acceptance criteria and CS comms. Timeline: RFC draft in 5 working days, review the following 2 days.

raj (ML Eng): I'll include the eval harness, example promptsets, and quant matrix. Need perf traces from infra — pinging @sam offline.

sam (Infra): I'll run perf sweep on benchmark traces and post numbers in thread by tomorrow EOD.

ops-bot: Note: New RFC draft thread created: rfc/optimize-recommendations-1850004321 (attach PRD link when ready).

maria (PM): Action items recap:
- raj: draft RFC eval + quant matrix
- elaine: console + API mockups
- sam: perf sweep + rollout runbook
- maria: consolidate acceptance criteria and customer comms

raj (ML Eng): One more: default KV cache should be per-tenant and opt-out for privacy-sensitive customers.

elaine (DevEx): Add CLI ergonomics for infra teams to programmatically run canary recommendations.

maria (PM): Good catches — I'll add both to RFC skeleton. Creating RFC skeleton now.
